text:
Maya Patel: quick heads-up — spotted something odd in the Optimize toolkit that could confuse migrations. the prefetch/KV example in batching.md still shows global `kv_prefetch: true` and a legacy Python snippet. i'm about to open a tiny PR to replace it with a route-scoped snippet + short-seq examples (py + go). link when i open: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/12345
Alex Chen: thanks — can you also call out the short-seq behavior change? we changed default batching heuristics for sequences < 64 tokens; docs should recommend `short_seq_mode` and show `max_batch_tokens` guidance.
Maya Patel: yep added that to the PR. draft python snippet i put in the description:```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
# route-scoped batching + kv prefetch
client.optimize.update_route("chat-route", {
    "batching": {"max_batch_tokens": 1024, "short_seq_mode": True},
    "kv_prefetch": {"enabled": True, "prefix_cache_size": 512}
})
```
Jordan Rivera: small nit: the SDK method is `update_route_config` now (rename landed in sdk v0.8). also `kv_prefetch` is nested under `caching` in the schema. otherwise looks good.
Maya Patel: good catch — updating. i'll also add a one-liner about quant profiles: recommend `qprofile: small-8bit` for latency-sensitive low-precision runs; link to quant-profiles page.
Samir Gupta: can you add a Go snippet for platform folks? quick example for the streaming case would help. e.g. show how to set `ShortSeqMode` + `PrefetchCacheSize` in Go.
Maya Patel: dropping a minimal Go snippet in PR body now:```go
import ("github.com/redwood/inference/sdk")
client := sdk.NewClient()
config := sdk.RouteConfig{
    Batching: sdk.Batching{MaxBatchTokens: 1024, ShortSeqMode: true},
    Caching: sdk.Caching{KVPrefetch: sdk.KVPrefetch{Enabled: true, PrefixCacheSize: 512}},
}
client.UpdateRouteConfig("chat-route", config)
```
DocsBot: docs-pr-checker: link-checker started for PR #12345 — running anchors + hreflang checks
Maya Patel: @Jordan can you review the Go snippet for naming & style? also noticed the old anchor `#kv-prefetch` 404s; i'll add a redirect from `docs/optimize/batching.md#kv-prefetch` to `docs/optimize/caching.md#kv-prefetch`.
Jordan Rivera: i'll do a quick pass in ~20m. also suggest we add a tiny migration bullet: "If you relied on global kv_prefetch, move to route-scoped caching to avoid cross-route evictions." one sentence.
Alex Chen: add a short note about fallback quantization — when routing to fallback models use `qprofile: balanced-16bit` to avoid hallucination regressions; saves users from a common gotcha.
Maya Patel: added the migration bullet + fallback quant note. PR updated, CI link-check passed, tests green.
Jordan Rivera: reviewed, left two style nits, :thumbsup: on the substance.
Maya Patel: thanks — addressed nits and merged. changelog entry i used: `docs: consolidate prefetch example, add short-seq & quant profile snippets (py/go), fix kv-prefetch anchor`
Alex Chen: awesome, thanks for the quick turnaround. :rocket:
